note: Naive sparse Pauli propagation. Terms counted after each event, walking the circuit in reverse (Heisenberg picture). Implementation validated exact to 1e-9 against statevector on 16 small u3+cz cases.
verdict: CLOSED. Support explodes on P5, a circuit already solved by the MPO route, at 7.7% of the circuit. A method that cannot compute one <Z_0> on a solved control has no claim on P6.
